job.organization: University of California Office of the President

items.item_text: This is a TEMPORARY position within our Temporary Office of the President Staffing (TOPS) program.

Primary program responsibilities are for the Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts for the Faculty/Staff and Postdoctoral Scholars benefits programs, and oversight of the COBRA continuation coverage program.

As a Benefits Program Analyst 4, you will provide high-level planning, analysis and operational support for the systemwide health and welfare benefit programs for UC faculty, staff, retirees and their dependents.
Additional assignments may include assisting with management of benefits administration projects that span the Health & Welfare Benefits' portfolio.
Knowledge of UC employee benefits programs.
Knowledge of state and federal laws and regulations applicable to large group health and welfare benefit plans.
